title: sar peeto momino ke ye zarbat ki raat hai
body:
Sar peeto momino ke ye zarbat ki raat hai
daamaade shaahe dee'n ki shahadat ki raat hai
kehte hai dil se hydere safdar basad alam
ye aaqri quda ki ibaadat ki raat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sajde me haq ke qaasae daawar hua shaheed
aafat bapa karo ye qayamat ki raat hai
daare fana se hydere karraar uth gaye
ahle haram pe aaj museebat ki raat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte the roke zainabo kulsoom se ali
aao gale lago ke ye furqat ki raat hai
ro ro ke dil se kehte hai sibtaine mustafa kyu'n kar kategi haaye museebat ki raat hai
pursa do mustafa ke nawaso ko baap ka
<<DIVIDER>>
sar peeto rozadaaro ye aafat ki raat hai
